agreement_note: agreement 169/210 = 0.8048; the two settings disagree on 41 structures and happen to break even. IDENTICAL TOTALS ARE NOT THE SAME PREDICTIONS.

per_stratum_accuracy.note: n=30 per stratum; minimal vs default. Individually underpowered — reported as description, not as claims. This table is the sole support for the 'identical totals, different predictions' claim.
per_stratum_accuracy.reading: extended thinking helps on tetragonal (+0.133) and trigonal (+0.033), hurts on hexagonal (-0.133) and triclinic (-0.067) — the two strata where the cell metric is closest to degenerate. Cubic saturated at 1.000 under both; monoclinic unchanged to three decimals.

cost_latency_comparison.summary: default emits 5.4x the output tokens, costs 1.35x more, and takes 3.4x longer for IDENTICAL accuracy (130/210 = 0.6190 both legs)

notes: Paired null: 5.4x the reasoning tokens buys ZERO accuracy. Scope: one model (claude-opus-5), one prompt, one sample, one pair of settings. 'effort: minimal' is not identical to the released arms' configuration, only the closest reproducible stand-in.
